title: Provenance, Not Behaviour: A Serialisation Artifact in Edge-IIoTset and a Leakage-Free Benchmark for Precision-Agriculture Intrusion Detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.15761v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Edge-IIoTset is the reference benchmark for machine-learning intrusion detection in the industrial Internet of Things, and results reported on it cluster above 99%. We show that much of that performance is not intrusion detection. The preprocessing recipe distributed with the dataset instructs researchers to one-hot encode seven categorical columns. Four of them separate attack from normal traffic with an accuracy of 1.0000 on their own, through the spelling of the placeholder written for an absent protocol field: the string "0" in the normal-traffic branch of the dataset build against "0.0" in the attack branch. The label is recoverable from a serialisation artifact encoding file provenance, with no network behaviour modelled, and separates every row of both curated subsets. translated_title: 溯源而非行为：Edge-IIoTset中的序列化伪影与用于精准农业入侵检测的无泄漏基准
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15761v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：Edge-IIoTset是工业物联网中机器学习入侵检测的参考基准，其上报告的结果聚类在99%以上。我们表明，这种性能大部分并非入侵检测。与数据集一起分发的预处理配方指示研究人员对七个分类列进行独热编码。其中四列通过缺失协议字段的占位符拼写方式，单独就能以1.0000的准确率区分攻击流量与正常流量：正常流量分支中写入的字符串“0”与攻击分支中的“0.0”不同。标签可以从编码文件溯源的序列化伪影中恢复，无需建模任何网络行为，并且能区分两个精选子集的每一行。在5折×3次重复交叉验证下，六个标准分类器中有五个恰好达到1.0000±0.0000的准确率，第六个达到0.99998。在修正后的条件下，结果显著下降。
tldr: 该论文揭示了Edge-IIoTset基准中的性能虚高源于数据序列化伪影（如“0”与“0.0”的拼写差异），而非真正的网络行为，并提出了一个无泄漏的基准以准确评估入侵检测模型。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that the high performance on the Edge-IIoTset benchmark stems from a serialisation artifact (e.g., "0" vs "0.0" spelling differences) encoding file provenance rather than network behaviour, and proposes a leakage-free benchmark for accurate intrusion detection evaluation.
